content:
maria: RFC follow-up — iterator ergonomics across Python/TS/Go. quick summary: i think we should return Page objects that include a resume_token and per-item seq_id. retries should live in the transport layer, not the iterator. optional client-side dedup for duped items. thoughts?

alex: can you sketch the API shapes? seeing examples helps. :eyes:

maria: sure, rough sketches below. note: these are intentionally minimal to show ergonomics, not full impl.

maria: Python (async iterator):
```py
class Page:
    items: List[Dict]
    resume_token: str  # opaq

async def list_things(...)-> AsyncIterator[Page]:
    ...

# consumption
async for page in client.list_things(q):
    for item in page.items:
        ...
    save(page.resume_token)
```

maria: TS (AsyncIterable):
```ts
type Page = { items: Record<string, any>[]; resumeToken?: string }
async function listThings(q): AsyncIterable<Page>
// usage
for await (const page of client.listThings(q)) { ... }
```

maria: Go (channel / iterator):
```go
type Page struct { Items []map[string]any; ResumeToken string }
func (c *Client) ListThings(ctx context.Context, q Query) <-chan Page
// usage: range over channel, or provide Iterator{Next() (Page, error)} wrapper
```

jamie: why Page vs streaming individual items? are we losing latency?

maria: good q. pages let us batch per-API semantics (server-side paging) and attach resume_token easily. for low-latency streaming of single items we still support a stream endpoint. the iterator shape is for the paginated list API.

sid: important: what about partial page duplication on retry? e.g., transport retries after sending a few items, server re-sends overlapping chunk. how do clients dedupe?

maria: plan: make resume_token point at last-complete-item boundary plus include per-item seq_id. token format v1:{model}:{deployment}:{offset_seq}. on resume we request from offset_seq+1. if server can't honor token (model/version mismatch), return 410-like error and SDK surface returns ErrResumeInvalid so callers can refetch from start or surface advisory.

kevin: if we require per-item seq_id we need model/server to emit stable ids. that's an infra change. is that acceptable?

maria: yes, infra asked for this earlier X. it's an extra field but unlocks precise resume/dedup. fallback for older models: resume_token points at page boundary only, and SDK falls back to best-effort dedup by content-hash (opt-in).

jamie: retries: you said keep them in transport. concretely: transport does idempotent retries for chunk fetches using an idempotency token header. iterator shouldn't re-run user callbacks.

maria: exactly. transport handles transient network/errors with exponential backoff + full jitter. retry policy is configurable per-client with sane defaults (max_attempts=5, base_ms=100, max_ms=10000). iterator only surfaces final errors.

sid: what about long polling vs streaming transports? e.g., websocket / http2 vs repeated page GETs. resume semantics differ.

maria: propose unified resume semantics across transports: resume_token is portable. streaming transports should emit sequence markers at item boundaries. if streaming connection dies mid-item, transport should attempt reconnect with idempotency token and server will honor resume_token to skip already-delivered items. if not possible, fall back to page-level resume.

alex: concern: client-side dedupe adds memory/cpu. opt-in feature?

maria: yes, default off. enable_dedupe={false} by default. small bounded LRU by seq_id window when on. document cost.

kevin: edge case: A/B rollouts where model semantics change between requests. resume_token tied to model+deployment helps there. also log clear message to user if resume fails.

maria: exactly. token schema v1 includes model_id & deployment_id; servers will reject incompatible tokens. SDK surfaces explicit ErrResumeMismatch with details.

jamie: i can prototype TS AsyncIterable shape + opt-in dedupe flag. sid can do Go iterator ergonomics. alex will own Python async iterator shim. can we sync tomorrow 10am?

sid: SG. i'll stub server contract for seq_id + token format so infra can estimate effort.

alex: :thumbsup: i'll take the python shim and make sure the async iterator exposes a .resume(token) helper.

kevin: i'll coordinate infra and K. we'll aim for backward-compatible rollout with feature flag.

deploy-bot: deploy/ci: new job queued for 'eng-platform/prototype-resume-token' (build #4789) :rocket:

maria: thanks all. i'll update the RFC with these concrete decisions (page objects, resume_token v1, transport-owned retries, opt-in client dedupe, token error semantics). will add small API sketches and migration notes. :white_check_mark:

alex: one more tiny note — consider providing convenience helper to convert resume_token -> human readable metadata (model/deploy/offset). handy for debugging.

maria: good call, will add `client.parse_resume_token` helper and wire into console logs.

jamie: sounds good. see you tomorrow.
